relevance_note: The paper gives individual-level ALDH5A1 genotype data for people with SSADH deficiency ('The study included the genetic information of 58 (1:1 male/female ratio) individuals from 50 unrelated families with 32 ALDH5A1 allelic variants'), so identifiable in-scope individuals with an ALDH5A1 variant are described.
method_note: Worked by reading the full text and tables by hand, then a short Python script transcribed Table 2 (patient number, both alleles, zygosity), Table 1 (nucleotide and protein strings) and Table 4 straight from the Markdown; the script output was checked line by line against the printed tables. Scope: the 58 people of Table 2 plus 'patient # 59' (see contradictions). Labels: Table 2 patients have no label column, only a bare 'Patient' number, so they are 'Table 2 #<n>' (v4 rule); Table 2 columns are Patient, Allele_1, Allele_2, Zygosity, Protein variants combination, Effect, and the label span is the row's first cell, e.g. '| 1 |'. The text's own label 'patient # 59' is kept verbatim; the same people are also called '#1', '#4' ... in the Results. Contradictions and oddities found: (1) the paper states 58 individuals and Table 2 has 58 rows, but the Results describe a 'patient # 59' whose alleles (c.1234C > T, c.1015-3C > G) are exactly those of Table 2 #55; I did not merge them (never merge two people) and gave 'patient # 59' its own row - probably a misprint. (2) Table 2 #37 prints 'c.278C > T' where Table 1 and the text print c.278G > T for C93F; recorded as printed and the protein left not reported, because Table 1 has no row for c.278C > T. (3) Table 2 #44 prints 'c608C > T'/'c608C >T' without the dot (Table 1: c.608C > T); recorded as printed. (4) c.1402 + 2T >C in Table 1 is printed 'c.1402 + 2T > C' in Table 2; the Table 2 form is used for the variant string. (5) Table 1 prints protein 'G520R' for c.1558G > C while the text calls it the 'G520A substitution (c.1558G > C)'. (6) Many compound heterozygotes show 'Hemizygote ... homotetramers' in the protein-combination column while the zygosity column says 'Compound heterozygosis'; zygosity is taken from the zygosity column. (7) Table 1 gives c.612G > A as W204X while Table 2 calls the same alleles 'Truncated protein'. (8) Table 2 #11 and #36 call the G176R allele 'G176E'. (9) The Discussion says the study included '58 SSADHD participants' with '41 unique allelic combinations' while Table 2 lists 58 rows; this is not a contradiction of patient numbers. Decisions: variant_type is given only where the paper names the exact variant with a class (Table 1's 'Splice site' rows for the six splice-site variants; 'an additional missense variant (c.278G > T)'; 'an additional non-sense mutation (c.1234C > T)'; 'the deletion of chromosome 6p22.3 in its entirety'). The paper's other class counts ('64 variants (55%) were missense, 23 non-sense (20%), 16 splice-site (14%), and 12 frameshift (10%)') are cohort-level and list several values, so per D-29 they are left not reported for individual variants; for the same reason pathogenicity is not reported for every variant, because the paper states it only for the cohort ('the 32 allelic variants ... were pathogenic'; 'all missense variants were determined to have a pathogenic clinical significance'). functional_evidence_statement is not reported: the per-variant evidence is in silico prediction (SIFT, POLYPHEN-2, CUPSAT, SpliceAI, PyMOL) and no functional assay was performed. Phenotypes: no clinical feature is reported per patient - Table 4 and the Results give counts by group without names, and counts without names exclude no one - so every checklist item is 'not reported' except the one feature stated for 'patient # 59' (drug-resistant seizures). Sex, age, ethnicity, treatment and vital status are given only at group level. Consanguinity is 'yes' for the nine Table 2 rows carrying the '*' defined by 'Table notes: *Consanguinity.' (patients 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 29, 32, 33, 45, which matches Table 4's 3/16, 6/35 and 0/7); the other rows are left 'not reported' because nothing is stated for them. Table 4's consanguinity row holds stacked values in single cells ('6 (21) 0 (0)'), which were not assigned to individuals. No parental testing is reported, so inheritance is not reported for any variant. is_proband is false for everyone (no proband or index case is named) and cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is false (no earlier report of these patients is mentioned); both have span null because the paper states nothing to quote. Protein variants are printed without the 'p.' prefix and are copied as printed.
